_comment: Playwright configs that no PR workflow runs directly. Each is nightly (listed in nightly.yml), manual, or manual-stack, with a reason. frontend/scripts/check-playwright-configs.mjs fails CI on any config that is neither referenced by a workflow nor listed here.
